<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peaks: a strong +1 Da peak (~16 % of base) matches the ^13C pattern, and a +2 Da peak (~4–5 % of base) matches the characteristic ^34S abundance. No other element shows its distinctive isotopic intensity ratios. Therefore, carbon and sulfur can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
